## Church leaders

Begin the shift the dashboard implies: develop a fruit-of-the-Spirit assessment rhythm for individual and communal reflection; form small groups around cultivating specific fruits; pair mature believers with newer ones; redesign one program explicitly around the fruit it should bear; partner with local organizations who can tell you honestly what your community's fruit tastes like from outside. Let technology serve connection and accountability in this — never the scoreboard.
